description: Returns the validator set at the specified height including addresses, public keys, and voting power. This is canonical consensus data about who can produce blocks.

height.description: Block height to query. If omitted or 0, returns the current validator set.

page.description: Page number for pagination (1-indexed). Default is 1.

per_page.description: Number of validators per page. Default is 30, max is 100.

name: get_cometbft_validators
